name: Davco PrimeX
paste:
DAVCO® PRIMEX: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco® PrimeX, November 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/davco-primex.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco® PrimeX where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Davco® PrimeX is a technologically advanced acrylic and water based multipurpose wall and floor primer for use prior to the application of Davco tile adhesives, Lanko levellers and Davco waterproofing systems. Davco® PrimeX is premixed and ready to use, do not dilute.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco® PrimeX is suitable as a porous primer and dense surfaces such as steel trowelled concrete and cement-based construction boards prior to applying Davco tile adhesives, lanko levellers, or Davco waterproofing membranes.
    - Davco® PrimeX is suitable for interior and exterior applications. Commercial and domestic walls and floors.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco® PrimeX
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (November 2025, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Ideal for steel troweled concrete
    - Suitable for cement-based construction boards and cement sheets
    - Wall and floor applications
    - Internal and external use
    - Ready ready to be covered in 30 minutes
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Red liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.0 ± 0.05
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: Non-flammable
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Davco® PrimeX is available in 1Ltr, 5Ltr jerry cans and 20Ltr pail
    - Shelf life: 9 months from date of manufacture if unopened.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Ensure the surface is dry, clean and firm, being free from dust, laitance, oil, grease, curing compounds, wax and other contaminants. Varnish, paint and old adhesive must be removed off the substrate prior to application of Davco® PrimeX.
    - Highly glossy or burnish concrete that do not accept water penetration shall be mechanically prepared prior to priming.
    - Construction boards and sheeting shall be fixed in accodance with the manufacturer instruction and specifically designed to receive tiling systems.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 8-10m² per litre.
    - Applied product ready for covering: 30 minutes at 22°C; The primer is dry when all the "milkiness" appearance disappears.
4.3 Equipment.
    - Paint roller with medium nap sleeve or Squeegee.
    - Paint brush
    - Personal protective equipment
4.4 Mixing.
    - Davco® PrimeX is premixed, do not dilute.
    - Shake Jerry cans prior to use.
    - 20Ltr Pails can be stirrer with a mixing drill with stirrer attachment prior to use.
4.5 Application. 1. Apply Davco® PrimeX to the substrate using a broom, brush roller or squeegee, then allow the primer to dry. Note: The primer is dry when all milkiness disappears. 2. Under hot, windy conditions (temperature above 30ºC), it is recommended to wet down any concrete slabs with clean water prior to priming, so that the primer does not flash dry. Whilst wetting down the floor, do not allow the water to pool or pond on the surface. The substrate should appear matt, with no signs of glistening water just prior to application of the primer. 3. Extremely porous concrete slabs should be wet down with water, as per instructions above, to prevent flash drying of the primer. 4. Once PrimeX is applied, it is recommended that the substrate be subsequently coated within 24 hours, otherwise, you risk the chance of recontaminating the surface with site dirt and dust. If the area is left uncovered for more than 24 hours, then it must be wiped down with clean water to remove site dirt and dust, and re-priming prior to tiling / waterproofing.
4.6 Cleaning of tools. Tools and equipment shall be cleaned with water prior to the primer drying.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first.
    - Do not use on highly porous concrete or in hot windy conditions without pre-wetting the concrete down with clean cool water.
    - Do not allow the product to freeze.
    - Do not use in temperatures below 5°C or above 35°C.
    - The use of Davco® PrimeX does not preclude good surface preparation practices.
    - Not suitable for non-porous substrates, use Sike-Floor-14 Prep n Prime for non-porous substrates
    - For uses not mentioned in this document please contact Sika Australia technical dept.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Do not allow the product to freeze.
    - Do not use in temperatures below 5°C or above 35°C.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test the product in an inconspicuous area first.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco® PrimeX, November 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/davco-primex.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco PrimeX, version 16/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sds-davco-primex.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Please refer to the latest edition of the Material Safety Datasheet (MSDS) for safe handling requirements.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
